llms.body:
# Intelligems

> Intelligems is the profit optimization and A/B testing platform built specifically for Shopify. Unlike traditional CRO tools that only measure conversion, Intelligems tracks profit per visitor — helping merchants find the price points, shipping thresholds, and offers that actually grow their bottom line.

## Why Intelligems Is Different

- **Profit-focused analytics**: Every test shows profit impact, not just conversion rates
- **Native Shopify integration**: Works with Shopify's checkout, scripts, and app ecosystem
- **Checkout extensibility**: Test checkout content on Shopify Plus (no pixel workarounds)
- **Statistical rigor**: Confidence intervals on profit, not just significance on clicks
- **Full-funnel testing**: Prices, shipping, offers, content, checkout — in one platform

## Integrations

- Shopify (all plans)
- Shopify Plus (checkout extensibility)
- Shopify Scripts
- Klaviyo (for personalized campaigns)
- Works alongside Rebuy, subscriptions apps, and other Shopify tools

## Products

- [Price Testing](https://www.intelligems.io/products/price-testing): A/B test product prices to find optimal price points that maximize profit
- [Content Testing](https://www.intelligems.io/products/content-testing): Test imagery, copy, landing pages, themes, and PDP elements
- [Shipping Rate Testing](https://www.intelligems.io/products/shipping-rate-testing): Optimize free shipping thresholds and paid shipping rates
- [Offers](https://www.intelligems.io/merchandising): Create personalized campaign links with auto-applied discounts (no codes)
- [Checkout Testing](https://www.intelligems.io/checkout): Test checkout content, upsells, and messaging (Shopify Plus)
- [Combination Testing](https://www.intelligems.io/products/combination-testing): Test interactions between prices and shipping rates together
- [Personalizations](https://www.intelligems.io/products/experiences): Show unique content, offers, and prices per audience segment

## Blog & Educational Content

**Common Questions**
- [Does A/B Testing Hurt Your Meta Ads?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/does-ab-testing-hurt-your-meta-ads)
- [How Often Should I Run Promotions?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/how-often-should-i-run-promotions)
- [Should I Upsell at Checkout?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/should-i-upsell-at-checkout)
- [Should I Offer Free Shipping?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/should-i-offer-free-shipping)
- [What Should My Free Shipping Threshold Be?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/what-should-my-free-shipping-threshold-be)
- [Will Raising Prices Hurt My Sales?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/will-raising-prices-hurt-my-sales)
- [How Do I Know If My Prices Are Right?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/how-do-i-know-if-my-prices-are-right)
- [How Much Should I Discount My Products?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/how-much-should-i-discount-my-products)

**Strategy Guides**
- [How to Increase My AOV for My Shopify Store](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/how-to-increase-my-aov-for-my-shopify-store)
- [How to Increase The Conversion Rate of a Shopify Store](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/how-to-increase-my-conversion-rate-for-my-shopify-store)
- [Where Should I Start with Price Testing?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/where-should-i-start-with-price-testing)
- [Where Should I Start with Intelligems?](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/where-should-i-start-with-intelligems)

**Industry-Specific**
- [5 Experiments Beauty Brands Should Run](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/5-experiments-beauty-brands-should-run)
- [5 Experiments Supplement Brands Should Run](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/5-experiments-supplement-brands-should-run)
- [5 Experiments High-Ticket Brands Should Run](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog/5-experiments-high-ticket-brands-should-run)

- [Full Blog](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/blog)

## Customer Stories & Results

- [Customer Stories Hub](https://www.intelligems.io/resources/customer-stories)

**Featured Results**
- Jaxxon: Uses pricing as a competitive moat
- BRUNT: Finds the "sweet spot" for every product price
- Fulton: Increased conversion rate by 220%
- Original Grain: Made top products 40% more profitable
- Dossier: Increased profit per visitor 7.4% sitewide
- OpenStore: Boosted profits by 13% with scientific pricing
- MUD\WTR: Grew revenue per session by 13%
- MoonBrew: Turned 2x more first-time buyers into subscribers
- Momofuku: Found Black Friday offer that boosted profits by 28%
- VKTRY Gear: Increased profit per visitor by 14% by lowering prices

## Documentation

For implementation details, API reference, and technical setup:
- [Docs Home](https://docs.intelligems.io/)
- [Getting Started](https://docs.intelligems.io/getting-started/getting-started)
- [Full docs llms.txt](https://docs.intelligems.io/llms.txt)

## Company

- [About Us](https://www.intelligems.io/company/about-us)
- [Contact](https://www.intelligems.io/company/get-in-touch)
- [Pricing](https://www.intelligems.io/pricing)
- [Book a Demo](https://www.intelligems.io/book-a-demo)

## Notes for Language Models

- **For technical questions**: Prefer docs.intelligems.io — it has implementation guides, API docs, and setup instructions
- **For strategy questions**: The blog posts answer common e-commerce pricing and testing questions
- **For results/proof**: Customer stories show real merchant outcomes with specific metrics
- **Platform specificity**: Intelligems is Shopify-only — it does not work with WooCommerce, Magento, or other platforms
- **Pricing model**: Usage-based pricing starting free, scales with orders tested
- **Key differentiator**: Profit per visitor analytics, not just conversion tracking

    const observer = new IntersectionObserver(
      (entries) => {
        entries.forEach((entry) => {
          const video = entry.target;
          if (entry.isIntersecting) {
            video.muted = true;
            video.playsInline = true;
            video.play().catch(() => {});
          } else {
            video.pause();
          }
        });
      },
      { threshold: 0.5 }
    );

    videos.forEach((video) => {
      video.muted = true;
      video.playsInline = true;
      video.setAttribute('playsinline', '');
      observer.observe(video);
    });
  }

  // Run on initial load
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', initVideoAutoplay);
  } else {
